used_script:
Slide 1: Low-prep writing activities

Slide 2: Quick warm-up
Start with one focused prompt and a visible timer.

Slide 3: Model the first line
Give students one example so they can enter faster.

Slide 4: Reduce prep
Reuse the same worksheet with a different writing angle.

Slide 5: Raise participation
Let students draft first, then share with a partner.

Slide 6: Keep the pace
Use short reflection prompts instead of long corrections.
